# KIF13A (kinesin family member 13A)

Entrez ID: 63971
Chromosome (GRCh38): 6:17758198-17988274 (strand: -1)
UniProt: Q9H1H9
Type: protein-coding
Source: NCBI Gene / MyGene.info

## Summary (NCBI Gene)

This gene encodes a member of the kinesin family of microtubule-based motor proteins that function in the positioning of endosomes. This family member can direct mannose-6-phosphate receptor-containing vesicles from the trans-Golgi network to the plasma membrane, and it is necessary for the steady-state distribution of late endosomes/lysosomes.
Diseases: glomerulonephritis, breast adenosis, lagophthalmos, liver disorder, multinodular goiter
